critical_code_review_comments: observability.py uses deprecated sentry_sdk.configure_scope() context manager — sentry-sdk 2.x prefers sentry_sdk.get_current_scope() / set_tag at module level. Currently still works but emits a DeprecationWarning at init when DSN is set. Replace `with sentry_sdk.configure_scope() as scope: scope.set_tag(...)` with `sentry_sdk.set_tag('service', 'a1-field-pro-backend')`.

CommandPaletteContext.jsx: Ctx default value provides `toggle/close` but not `open_` — any consumer reading `useCommandPalette().open_` outside the provider tree will get undefined. Either remove `open_` from the exported shape (it's unused — CommandPalette.jsx only reads `open, close`) or add `open_: ()=>{}` to the default ctx object.
CommandPaletteContext.jsx useEffect depends on `open` so the listener is rebound every toggle — micro-inefficiency only. Use a ref for `open` and depend on `[]` to avoid the rebind churn.
observability.capture_request_id() defined but unused — middleware.py uses sentry_sdk.set_tag directly. Either wire it in (DRY) or delete the helper.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sentry stays in no-op mode unless SENTRY_DSN env var is set (intentional dev default). To simulate prod path locally, add SENTRY_DSN=https://anything@example.invalid/1 to backend/.env, restart backend, hit /api/health — `sentry` flips to true (note: sentry-sdk will attempt to ship to the invalid host but fail silently; do NOT use a real DSN). CommandPalette state is now in React context (src/context/CommandPaletteContext.jsx) — any new component needing to open the palette should `import { useCommandPalette } from '../context/CommandPaletteContext'` and call `ctx.toggle()` / `ctx.open_()`. Don't bring back window.dispatchEvent. iteration_29 pytest XML at /app/test_reports/pytest/iteration_29_results.xml (51 passed in 9.63s).
